cards.text: Israel has demanded a king, and the LORD told Samuel to appoint one (1 Samuel 8:5, 22). Samuel is Israel's prophet and judge (1 Samuel 3:20; 7:15). Now meet Kish, a powerful man from the tribe of Benjamin.

cards.question: Kish has a son named Saul, choice and handsome, without equal among the Israelites. What else stands out about Saul?

answers.text: He's a head taller than anyone
He's the fastest runner in Israel
He's the strongest man in Benjamin

cards.text: One day Kish's donkeys wander off. Kish tells Saul to take one of the servants and go look for them.

cards.question: Saul and the servant search the hill country of Ephraim, then Shalishah, then Shaalim, then the land of Benjamin. True or false: they find the donkeys in the land of Benjamin.

cards.text: Still no donkeys, and now they reach the land of Zuph. I once spent a whole afternoon hunting one sprinkle under my oven, so I feel this man's pain.

cards.question: When they reach the land of Zuph, Saul tells the servant they should go back home. True or false: Saul says it's because it's getting dark.

cards.text: Saul's real worry: stay gone long enough, and his father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about them. But the servant says there's a highly respected man of God in this city, and everything he says surely comes to pass.

cards.question: What does the servant hope the man of God in this city will do for them?

answers.text: Tell them which way to go

cards.text: Saul asks, if they do go, what can they give the man? The bread in their packs is gone, and they've got no gift to take to the man of God.

cards.question: Then Saul's servant speaks up. What does he have in his hand to give the man of God?
A quick side note in the text: back then, someone going to ask God something would say, let's go to the seer. In the writer's day, a seer was called a ___.

cards.text: A quarter shekel, and friend, I came home from a bakery's closing sale with a 25 cent sticker on me, so I am NOT judging the budget. Saul says good, let's go, and they head for the city where the man of God is.
They're climbing the hill to the city when they meet some young women coming out to draw water. Saul and the servant ask them, "Is the seer here?"

cards.question: Saul and his servant ask the young women on the hill if the seer is in town. What do the young women answer?

answers.text: He left this morning for Ramah

cards.question: The young women explain the people have a sacrifice on the high place today. True or false: the people won't eat until the seer comes and blesses the sacrifice.

cards.text: Up they go toward the city, and just as they're walking in, there's Samuel coming toward them. Friend, after all those empty hills, that's the fastest anything has gone right for these two.

cards.question: As Saul and his servant enter the city, Samuel comes toward them. Where is Samuel headed?

cards.text: Now hold on, friend. The day before Saul showed up, the LORD had revealed something to Samuel.

cards.question: What does the LORD tell Samuel will happen at this time tomorrow?

answers.text: A man from Benjamin will come
A man from Ephraim will come
A man from Judah will come

cards.question: The LORD tells Samuel to anoint this man ___ over His people Israel.
The LORD says this man will save His people from someone's hand. Whose?

cards.text: And the LORD says why. He has looked upon His people, because their cry has come to Him.
Back to the gate. When Samuel sees Saul, the LORD tells him, "Here is the man of whom I spoke; he shall rule over My people."
And Saul walks right up to Samuel in the gateway and asks where the seer's house is. Friend, he's asking the seer for directions to the seer, and he has NO idea.

cards.question: Samuel tells Saul he's the seer. Then he gives Saul an invitation. What is it?

answers.text: Eat with him at the high place today
Wait at the city gate until evening
Meet him back here next week

cards.question: Samuel brings up the donkeys Saul lost three days ago. True or false: Samuel tells Saul to keep looking for them.

cards.text: The donkeys have been found, and friend, all Saul asked this man for was directions. Then Samuel goes bigger and asks who all the desire of Israel is upon, if not Saul and his father's house.

cards.question: How does Saul answer Samuel's big words about all the desire of Israel?

answers.text: He says his tribe and clan are the smallest
He says he isn't old enough to lead anyone
He says his father needs him back at home

cards.text: Smallest tribe, least clan, so why would Samuel say such a thing? Friend, when an angel came to call me out of a junk drawer, I asked him if he had the right drawer, so I GET it.

cards.question: Samuel brings Saul and his servant into the hall and seats them in the place of ___ among about thirty guests.

cards.text: Then Samuel tells the cook to bring the portion he gave him and told him to set aside.

cards.question: The cook sets the leg and what was attached to it in front of Saul. True or false: Samuel says it was kept for Saul for this occasion.

cards.text: Friend, the man came to town hunting DONKEYS and ended up in the place of honor with a portion set apart just for him. Saul dines with Samuel that day, and back down in the city, they talk up on Samuel's roof.
Just before dawn, Samuel calls up to Saul on the roof to get ready, and they head out together. At the edge of the city, Samuel tells Saul to send the servant on ahead.

cards.question: Samuel tells Saul to stay behind for a while at the edge of the city. Why?

answers.text: So Samuel can reveal the word of God
So Samuel can pray for his family
So Samuel can bless his trip home

cards.question: Alone with Saul at the edge of the city, Samuel takes out a flask of oil. What does he do with it?

answers.text: Gives it to Saul to keep

cards.text: Then Samuel kisses him and says, "Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over His inheritance?" No crowd, just two men at the edge of the city.

Then Samuel tells Saul that when he leaves today, he'll find two men at the tomb of Rachel, Jacob's wife (Genesis 29:28), in Zelzah on the border of Benjamin. They'll tell him the donkeys have been found, and his father has stopped worrying about the donkeys and started worrying about him.
Saul CALLED that one back in Zuph, friend. Next, at the Oak of Tabor, three men going up to God at Bethel will meet him, carrying three young goats, three loaves of bread and a skin of wine.

cards.question: The three men at the Oak of Tabor will greet Saul. What will they give him?

cards.text: Then at Gibeah of God, where the Philistines have an outpost, Saul will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, prophesying. They'll have harps, tambourines, flutes AND lyres out in front, so friend, that's not a walk, that's a parade.

cards.question: When Saul meets that group of prophets, what does Samuel say will happen to him?

answers.text: The Spirit of the LORD will rush upon him
He will be handed a harp and told to play
He will be chased off by the Philistines

cards.question: Samuel says more about what will happen at Gibeah. True or false: Samuel says Saul will be transformed into a different person.
Samuel tells Saul that when these signs come, he should do as the occasion demands, for ___ is with him.
Samuel tells Saul to go ahead of him to Gilgal and wait seven days. When Samuel comes, what will he do?

answers.text: Offer sacrifices and show Saul what to do
Lead the army against the Philistines
Bring Saul back home to his father

cards.question: As Saul turns to leave Samuel, God changes Saul's ___.
Samuel gave Saul a whole list of signs. True or false: those signs take weeks to come to pass.

cards.text: At Gibeah a group of prophets meets him. The Spirit of God rushes upon him, and Saul prophesies right along with them.

cards.question: Everyone who knew Saul before sees what's happening at Gibeah. What's the first thing they ask one another?

answers.text: What has happened to the son of Kish
Who taught the son of Kish to play
When did the son of Kish come back

cards.text: They also ask, "Is Saul also among the prophets?" A man who lives there replies, "And who is their father?" and that line becomes a proverb. Friend, Saul left home to find donkeys and ended up a SAYING.

When Saul finishes prophesying, he goes up to the high place. Then Saul's uncle asks where he and the servant went, and Saul says they went looking for the donkeys and, when they couldn't find them, went to Samuel.
His uncle asks what Samuel said to them. Saul tells him Samuel assured them the donkeys had been found.

cards.question: True or false: Saul also tells his uncle what Samuel said about the kingship.

cards.text: We'll pause right here, friend. Keep your apron on, because Saul's story has a LOT more coming.
